inputSpec.name: associations_parquet
inputSpec.help: Gene-trait associations with LOFTEE correlation direction. Columns: region, phenotype, correlation.

inputSpec.name: annotations_parquet
inputSpec.help: Variant annotations with all built-in scores. Columns: id, region, + score columns.

inputSpec.name: appv_parquet
inputSpec.help: Average phenotype per variant. Columns: id, phenotype, mean_pheno_value, n_individuals.

inputSpec.name: custom_scores_parquet
inputSpec.help: Custom model scores. Format: id + optional region + float columns per model.

inputSpec.name: model_labels
inputSpec.help: Comma-separated display names for custom score columns, in column order.

inputSpec.name: model_directions
inputSpec.help: Comma-separated 1 or -1 per custom model. Default: 1 for all.

inputSpec.name: fill_missing_scores
inputSpec.help: If true, fill custom score nulls with 0.0. If false, variants without score excluded for that model.

inputSpec.name: variant_class
inputSpec.help: Preset variant class name from bundled config, or 'other'.

inputSpec.name: variant_class_config_yaml
inputSpec.help: Required if variant_class='other'. YAML in same format as bundled config.

inputSpec.name: annotation_config_yaml
inputSpec.help: Override bundled annotation config (label/color/direction per tool).
